descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S02 Nursing Home: Encounter tab, step-2 dictation, Save & Extract, Generate, Post-Round (live AI)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Both entry paths reach the same place: 'Begin Encounter' on the Pre-Round tab and the Encounter tab open the same encounter view (dictation box, Save & Extract, Generate). (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U2 Save & Extract closes the open tasks whose results are dictated in ordinary phrasing, once and with no duplicates, leaves unmatched tasks open, and records the dictated medication events. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 2; TFA-92592 rule 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U7 Bedside checks stay reminders, not findings: 'check for dysuria' never becomes 'reports dysuria'. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U8 A medication already given ('restarted metoprolol this morning') is documented as performed, not re-ordered. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 8) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U6 No placeholder tokens appear in the note: {ADDRESS}, {PHONE}, [Today's date], [Physician name]. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U9 Nursing Home notes have no signature or date line (PR #57) and never say 'yesterday'. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U10 Generate AI Note moves the physician to Post-Round with the generated note there. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • T4 No dictated fact silently disappears from the note (Principle 2). (TFA-94229 R9) — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-14 step 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh physician. The Nursing Home fixture resident has open tasks 'Recheck INR' and 'PT evaluation' and a held row 'Metoprolol tartrate 25 mg PO BID' (held {day-14}, soft BP)

When Switch to Nursing Home, open the resident, go straight to the Encounter tab, type the visit text, press Save & Extract, open Post-Round's tasks section, go back and press Generate Note & Finish, and read the note and tasks on Post-Round

Then 'Recheck INR' closes once, 'PT evaluation' stays open, a pharmacy task is added, metoprolol is recorded as restarted. Post-Round shows the note: restart documented as done, no dysuria finding, no placeholder, no signature or date line, no 'yesterday', every dictated fact present

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs strings below plus a backend probe of snf:get after cp1 and cp3: 'Recheck INR' done, 'PT evaluation' open, one pharmacy task (Nursing Home task rows have no accessible names, so done flags come from the probe). When metoprolol is still Held after Save & Extract, the run reports it with Q13. The note also gets the stock-normal phrases. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev.
